content: Hi! I'm trying to build a lean project on an HPC cluster right now, which runs versions of GLIBC of at most 2.28. I'm trying to build a project with lean version v4.30.0-rc2. When I try running lake exe cache get, I get errors like version GLIBC_2.29 not found. Is there any workaround to this?
That's extremely old, please build Lean from source (edit: which might in fact require disabling some features, I don't remember off the top of my head)
